// diagnostic

E0768

A bare argument follows a labelled one, so it names no parameter

What

A bare argument follows a labelled one, so it names no parameter

Why

Labels bind arguments by name, so a bare argument after one has no parameter to fill

Fix

Place positional arguments before the first labelled argument.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0768: tests/ui/arg_positional_after_label.stderr.

Error [jet.PositionalAfterLabel]: This argument to `schedule` follows a labelled one without a label
  --> tests/ui/arg_positional_after_label.jet:3:36
    |
  3 | run: fn() { _: schedule(repeat: 5, "backup", 30) }
    |                                    ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Labels bind by name, so a bare argument after one has no parameter to fill
 Fix: Label this argument, or move it before the labelled ones
